+"""Workday apply-flow signup integration coverage."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+
+from cloud.services.agent_runner._navigation_dependencies import (
+    AuthenticationStrategyRuntime,
+    build_navigation_auth_adapter,
+)
+from src.browser_runtime.page_ops.authentication import (
+    AuthMutationKind,
+    AuthMutationRequest,
+)
+from src.cli.auth import (
+    AuthFlowContext,
+    prepare_workday_apply_signup_form,
+    resolve_handler,
+    submit_workday_apply_signup,
+)
+from src.cli.auth.constants import WORKDAY_PLATFORM_ID
+from tests.graph._navigation_authentication_forms import FORM_CREDENTIALS, FormPage
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.integration
+
+_JOB_URL = "https://acme.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/jobs/42"
+_SIGNUP_REQUEST = AuthMutationRequest(
+    action_id="auth:workday:signup_submit",
+    kind=AuthMutationKind.SIGNUP_SUBMIT,
+    job_url=_JOB_URL,
+    pre_action_signature="navigation-step.v1:workday-signup",
+)
+
+
+async def test_workday_signup_helpers_fill_consent_and_submit_current_form() -> None:
+    page = FormPage.workday_signup()
+    handler = resolve_handler(WORKDAY_PLATFORM_ID)
+    assert handler is not None, "Workday handler must be registered for signup"
+    context = AuthFlowContext(page, _JOB_URL, handler, FORM_CREDENTIALS)
+
+    await prepare_workday_apply_signup_form(context)
+    did_submit = await submit_workday_apply_signup(page)
+
+    assert did_submit, "Workday helper must submit the active create-account form"
+    assert len(page.checks) == 2, "Workday signup must accept both required consents"
+    assert len(page.clicks) == 1, "Workday signup must click one submit control"
+
+
+async def test_graph_signup_submits_existing_workday_form_without_navigation(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+) -> None:
+    page = FormPage.workday_signup()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        "cloud.services.agent_runner._navigation_dependencies.get_active_page",
+        lambda: page,
+    )
+    adapter = build_navigation_auth_adapter(
+        strategies=AuthenticationStrategyRuntime(lambda: FORM_CREDENTIALS, None)
+    )
+
+    outcome = await adapter.mutate(_SIGNUP_REQUEST)
+
+    assert outcome == "verification_needed", (
+        "submitted Workday accounts must enter the graph verification cycle"
+    )
+    assert page.navigations == [], (
+        "an existing Workday create-account form must be submitted in place"
+    )
*** End Patch
